name: Hand Studio
description: Two sculptural hands on a dusty blush sweep, the most natural plinth there is.
lighting: Large soft side key, clean soft shadow on blush paper
subject: product
prompt: A seamless paper sweep in soft dusty blush fills the frame, matte and even, curving up into the wall with no horizon. In the middle ground a pair of graceful, anonymous hands rises into frame from below, cropped at the wrists, posed slowly and precisely like a dancer's, the open palms forming a quiet plinth. The skin is natural and even, the nails short and bare. A large soft key from one side models the fingers and casts one clean soft shadow onto the paper behind. Nothing else is in the set: blush paper, skin and soft light.
